decisions.summary: Transferred the urgency change from the committed preservation copies rather than from the live worktree, so the bytes that landed are the same bytes that were independently hash-verified, and the source checkout was never read at commit time.

Ran the entire Vitest ward suite discovered by glob (118 files) rather than the focused reason test. The recovery record states the last full run against this edit had one failure and was never re-run after the correction, so a focused pass would have re-created exactly the gap that record warns about.

Classified the three live checkouts as parked rather than historical in the current-truth manifest, because each still holds live work: the only copy of the urgency change, 139 untracked files the recovery order forbids cleaning, and the community WIP built on a reversed association rule.

questions.summary: Community team identity granularity is the owner's to settle: the ten placeholder teams are one per HomeRegion, so introducing a team identifier keyed on anything else means inventing a vocabulary he has not ruled on. Region may seed a default at referral time, but it must not decide membership afterwards.
Ward Verifier's verdict on R1 and R3 has not arrived. Nothing above should be treated as independently verified until it does; every check reported here is the Lead's own.
